name: MessageLinkEmbeds
description: Adds a preview to messages that link another message

settings.label: Message background color
settings.description: Background color for messages in rich embeds

settings.label: AutoMod embeds
settings.description: Use automod embeds instead of rich embeds (smaller but less info)

choices.label: Prefer automod embeds, but use rich embeds if some content can't be shown

settings.label: List mode
settings.description: Whether to use ID list as blacklist or whitelist

settings.label: ID List
settings.description: Guild/channel/user IDs to blacklist or whitelist (separate with comma)

notes: A message with links to Discord messages (up to five) gets a preview of each under it: where it is ("Server - #channel", "Direct Message - @name" or "Group DM" with the server's, user's or group's icon), its text (or "[no content, 2 attachments]"), its images, its author and when it was sent, drawn as an embed. Messages Qord doesn't have are fetched one at a time, newest first, once each, and the preview appears when they arrive; channels you can't see are skipped, and the ID list leaves out (or, as a whitelist, keeps only) links in those servers or channels or from those users.
gaps: Qord draws one style of preview for every "AutoMod embeds" setting and doesn't show the linked message's buttons or files; "Message background color" has no effect.
Mentions and channel links in the preview's text show as written.
There's no button to clear the linked message cache.
